name: family
cmd: set -e; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; TRACK_M_DISPOSABLE_PROFILE=1 bun research/track-m/install-cost-meter.ts /tmp/family-originals >/tmp/family-manifest; for mode in legacy rows both; do r=1; t=0; [ "$mode" = legacy ] && r=0; [ "$mode" = both ] && t=1; GDP_ROWS_SHARED=$r GDP_COUNTS_SHARED_TREES=$t TRACK_M_COST_PROFILE=1 taskset -c 0-3 bun research/track-m/profile-family.ts replay-input/input.json; done

name: test
cmd: set -e; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; bun test kernel/tree-reuse.test.ts kernel/prover-rows.test.ts core/count-cases.test.ts core/count-recovery/source-memo.test.ts

name: check
cmd: set -e; bash research/track-m/prepare-vendors.sh; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; bun run check
